description: This is a test source file for the AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer; it contains unit tests verifying correct analyzer behavior regarding the usage of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute on grain interfaces and implementations in Orleans.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A unit test class for AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer, verifying attribute usage enforcement in Orleans grain interface and implementation code.
